# Bankruptcy Means Test Online: Free Calculator [2026]
> Last updated: 2026-09-25

> Bankruptcy means test online. Free Chapter 7 and Chapter 13 means test calculator. Enter income and expenses for an instant 2026 eligibility result.

## About
meanstest.org is part of the Open Bankruptcy Project (openbankruptcyproject.org), a 501(c)(3) nonprofit building free, open-source tools for bankruptcy court transparency.
